CREATE FUNCTION CDN.SoundExPl( @sAkronim varchar(20) = '' ) RETURNS VarChar (20) as BEGIN
declare @iZmiana int declare @sTmpAkronim1 varchar (20) declare @sTmpAkronim2 varchar (20)
declare @sLitera varchar (1) declare @lDlugosc int declare @lZnak int declare @lNastepny int
set @sAkronim = upper ( @sAkronim ) set @iZmiana = 0 set @sTmpAkronim1 = @sAkronim set @sTmpAkronim2 = @sAkronim
while @iZmiana <> 1 begin -- znaki diakrytycznw set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ą' , 'A' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ć' , 'C' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ę' , 'E' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ł' , 'L' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ń' , 'N' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ś' , 'S' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ź' , 'S' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ż' , 'S' ) -- ortografia set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Ó' , 'U' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'CH', 'H' ) -- dwuznaki set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'ON', 'A' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'OM', 'A' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'IA', 'A' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'TRZ','C' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'CI', 'C' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'DZ', 'C' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'CZ', 'C' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'TS', 'C' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'EM', 'E' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'EN', 'E' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'IE', 'E' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'NI', 'N' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'IO', 'U' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'LU', 'U' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'SI', 'S' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'ZI', 'S' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'RZ', 'S' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'SZ', 'S' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'WZ', 'S' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'KS', 'X' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'KSI','X' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'QU', 'Q' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'KU', 'Q' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'KW', 'Q' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'PL', 'P' ) -- dziweki set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'D' , 'T' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'B' , 'P' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'W' , 'F' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'V' , 'F' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Z' , 'S' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'K' , 'C' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'G' , 'C' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , '0' , 'U' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'O' , 'U' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'Y' , 'I' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , 'J' , 'I' ) -- interpunkcja set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , '.' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , ',' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , ';' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , ':' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , '''' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , '"' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , '/' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , '!' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , '?' , '' ) set @sTmpAkronim1 = replace (@sTmpAkronim1 , '-' , '' ) -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- --
set @lZnak = 0 while @iZmiana <> 1 begin set @lDlugosc = len ( @sTmpAkronim1 ) set @lZnak = @lZnak + 1 if @lZnak > @lDlugosc break set @sLitera = substring ( @sTmpAkronim1 , @lZnak , 1 ) set @lNastepny = @lZnak if @sLitera = '' begin set @lZnak = @lZnak - 1 set @lNastepny = @lNastepny + 1 end else begin while @iZmiana <> 1 begin set @lNastepny = @lNastepny + 1 if @lNastepny > @lDlugosc break if @sLitera <> substring ( @sTmpAkronim1 , @lNastepny , 1) break end end set @sTmpAkronim1 = substring ( @sTmpAkronim1,1,@lZnak) + substring ( @sTmpAkronim1,@lNastepny,(@lDlugosc-@lNastepny)+1) end
-- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- if @sTmpAkronim1 = @sTmpAkronim2 break else set @sTmpAkronim2 = @sTmpAkronim1 end
return @sTmpAkronim1
END
